text:
All tests pass. The fix adds two steps after the initial replacement:

1. `re.sub(r"-+", "-", text)` — collapses consecutive hyphens into a single hyphen.
2. `text.strip("-")` — removes leading and trailing hyphens.

This ensures `slugify("Hello,  World!")` returns `"hello-world"` (not `"hello--world-"`) and `slugify("--a--b--")` returns `"a-b"`.

arguments.summary: Fixed `slugify` in `textkit/slug.py` by adding two post-processing steps: collapsing multiple consecutive hyphens into one (`re.sub(r"-+", "-", text)`) and stripping leading/trailing hyphens (`text.strip("-")`). This resolves the issue where double hyphens and trailing hyphens appeared in the output...
